newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish DCS mobile phone licenses to be set Mch 19.
newsitem.headline: Danish DCS mobile phone licenses to be set Mch 19.

text.p: Denmark's state telecommunications board said on Tuesday it would announce licenses for the new Danish DCS-1800 high frequency mobile telephone system on March 19.
"At a news conference in the morning of March 19, we will announce the winners of the new DCS-1800 mobile phone net licenses for Denmark," a board spokesman told Reuters.
Analysts expect a maximum single regional and three nationwide DCS-1800 licenses to be awarded in Denmark.
Five telecoms firms have submitted tenders for the licences, current mobile phone operators Denmark's Tele Danmark and Sonofon, Sweden's Telia and Netcom Systems and France Telecom Mobile.
